title: Tofu Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Chinese-inspired dish made with crispy tofu and a variety of vegetables, all cooked to perfection in a savory sauce.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the tofu from the skillet and set aside.
Add another tablespoon of oil to the skillet, then add the sliced yellow bell pepper and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the stir-fry sauce and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Return the tofu to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
Optional: sprinkle shredded american cheese on top of the tofu and serve.
